However it has three critical blockers: (1) a corrupted operator phone number for Day 3's primary activity provider, (2) an AI-generated source listed in researchSources violating the no-AI-content policy, and (3) the markdown file describes a materially different route from the JSON. Additionally, all pricing and hours are 16+ months old (last updated 2025-02-06) and need re-verification before the itinerary is promoted to users.

criticalIssues.issue: JSON data file and markdown content file describe materially different routes
criticalIssues.jsonRoute: Day 1 = Zip World Velocity 2 (Penrhyn Quarry, near Bethesda/Bangor), Pete's Eats Llanberis, Llanberis Path walk, YHA Llanberis. Day 2 = Snowdon summit hike, Moel Siabod Cafe Capel Curig, Plas y Brenin. Day 3 = Gorge walking near Bala, White Lion Hotel Bala.

criticalIssues.keyDiscrepancy: The JSON uses Zip World Velocity 2 at Penrhyn Quarry (LL57 4YG, near Bethesda) as the Day 1 headline activity. The markdown describes Zip World Fforest (Betws-y-Coed area, LL27 0JH) as the Day 1 activity. These are different Zip World sites at different ends of the A5 corridor — the routes are not interchangeable.
criticalIssues.furtherDiscrepancy: The markdown's cost section lists gorge walking at £65-95 pp; JSON has £50-75. The markdown omits the Bala leg entirely.
criticalIssues.action: Human editorial decision required: choose one canonical route and update the other file to match, or explicitly separate them into two distinct itineraries. The JSON version (Velocity 2 + Bala) is more detailed and better structured; the markdown appears to be an earlier draft.
